title: Clixad / free AI coding agent for your terminal
excerpt: A free AI coding agent for your terminal. npm install -g clixad, sign in with GitHub, and top up with a form or a survey, credited on completion.
content_html:
Every other coding agent $20/mo$100/mo$200/mo →$0/mo

Free AI coding
in your terminal.

Clixad is an AI coding agent you run in your terminal. It reads your project, writes code and runs commands, and asks before it changes anything.

No subscription, no card. Advertisers pay for your credits, and you spend them on models like Claude Opus 5 and Kimi K2.

5,000 credits on signup every model, no locked tiers nothing runs without your yes

get started

npm install -g clixad

Node 20 or newer. Then clixad login signs you in with GitHub and drops 5,000 credits in your wallet.

clixad · ~/acme-api ⠹ 4.2s

●readsrc/auth.ts

●editsrc/auth.ts+12−4

⚠Out of credits · balance 240

›How do you want to top up?

✓Credited · balance — · resuming

How you pay

Two ways to earn credits, and you pick every time.

Credits are how you pay the AI for its work, and models charge for the text they read and write. An advertiser pays us for a completed form or survey, and most of that money comes back to you as credits. Nothing starts on its own — you pick one when you run out.

Those are amounts the wall actually paid in Germany, credited on completion. They are ranges because the advertiser is pricing you and not your time — two surveys of the same length can pay more than twice as differently — and both what is on offer and what it pays change from country to country. Being screened out part way through pays nothing, which is the normal way an attempt ends rather than a fault.

See it run

Watch it run out of credits, and keep going.

Do the math

How many coding turns does one of those buy?

A turn is one question and one answer: read four files, change two lines, explain why. Pick what you are willing to do, and the table recalculates for every model in the catalog.

One 2 min form buys

— coding turns on Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite

A turn is about 20,000 tokens in and 1,500 out, and a token is roughly three quarters of a word. Credits are granted on completion, from what the advertiser actually paid: the payouts here were observed in Germany, offers pay differently per country and per advertiser, so your credits will too, and not qualifying for an offer part way through is a normal outcome rather than a fault. Every figure counts from the low end of the range.

Coding turns per model for the selected earn action, counted from the low end of its payout range
Model Credits per turn Turns, at least

Want that for $0? It is open — no invite, no card.

npm install -g clixad

How it works

How Clixad works, in three steps.

Install and sign in

npm install -g clixad, then GitHub. 5,000 credits are in your wallet before you have watched anything.

Point it at your project

It reads and searches your files, edits them and runs commands. Before it writes anything it shows you the diff and waits for a yes.

Out of credits?

Pick a form or a survey. Finish it and the credits land in seconds and the task carries on from where it stopped; get screened out and nothing is lost but the time.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is a coding agent?

A program you run in your terminal that works inside your project: it opens files, edits them, and runs commands like your test suite. Clixad shows you a diff of every change it wants to make and waits for you to approve it.

Is Clixad free to use?

Yes. There is no subscription and no card. You get 5,000 credits when you sign up, and after that you top up by filling in a form or taking a survey, credited on completion. Buying credits is possible, but never required.

How does Clixad make money?

Advertisers pay us for a completed form or survey. Most of that money goes straight back out to you as credits and we keep a small share. That share is the whole business, which is why the free tier is not a trial that quietly runs out.

Do I have to watch ads?

Only when you want more credits, and you choose which kind. A form pays well and a survey pays the most, and you are credited when the advertiser confirms you finished. Being screened out of a survey part way through pays nothing and is the normal case, not a fault. Nothing starts on its own: you open the page yourself, when you want it.

Which AI models can I use?

All of them. Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, Kimi K2, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Opus 5 are funded the same way. There are no locked tiers: a stronger model costs more credits per turn, so it costs more of your time.

Can advertisers see my code?

No. Ads live in a web page in your browser, next to the agent rather than inside it. Your code, your prompts and the name of your project are never sent to an advertiser.

Five steps, about a minute.

No card, no invite code, and nothing to watch before you start.

  1. npm install -g clixad — Node 20 or newer.
  2. clixad login prints a code and opens github.com/login/device. Paste it there.
  3. 5,000 credits land in your wallet on signup.
  4. clixad in your project. It asks before it changes anything.
  5. /earn when you run out: finish an offer and the task carries on.

您如何付款

有两种赚取学分的方式，您每次都可以选择。

积分是你向人工智能的工作付费的方式，模型则根据他们阅读和编写的文本收费。 广告商向我们支付填写完毕的表格或调查的费用，其中大部分钱都会以积分形式返还给您。 没有什么是自行开始的——当你用完的时候你会选择一个。

这些是德国实际支付的隔离墙金额，在竣工时记入。 它们是范围，因为广告商是在给你定价，而不是你的时间——两次相同长度的调查所支付的费用可能会相差两倍以上——而且不同国家提供的内容和支付的费用都不同。 中途被淘汰不会带来任何损失，这是尝试结束的正常方式，而不是错误。

它是如何运作的

Clixad 的工作原理分三个步骤。

安装并登录

npm install -g clixad，然后是 GitHub。 在您观看任何内容之前，您的钱包里就有 5,000 个积分。

将其指向您的项目

它读取和搜索您的文件、编辑它们并运行命令。 在写入任何内容之前，它会向您显示差异并等待“是”。

积分用完了？

选择表格或调查。 完成它，片尾字幕会在几秒钟内出现，任务会从停止的地方继续进行；被筛选掉，除了时间之外什么也没有丢失。

FAQ

常见问题

什么是编码剂？

您在终端中运行的程序，该程序在您的项目中运行：它打开文件、编辑文件并运行测试套件等命令。 Clixad 会向您显示它想要进行的每个更改的差异，并等待您批准。

Clixad 可以免费使用吗？

是的。 没有订阅，也没有卡。 注册后您将获得 5,000 积分，之后您可以通过填写表格或参加调查来充值，完成后即可获得积分。 购买积分是可能的，但不是必需的。

Clixad如何赚钱？

广告商向我们支付填写完整的表格或调查的费用。 大部分资金都会作为积分直接返还给您，我们保留一小部分。 该份额就是整个业务，这就是为什么免费套餐不是一个会悄悄耗尽的试用版。

我必须看广告吗？

只有当你想要更多学分时，你才选择哪种。 表格的报酬很高，调查的报酬最高，当广告商确认您完成后，您就会被记入贷方。 中途被排除在调查之外无需支付任何费用，这是正常情况，而不是过错。 没有什么是自行开始的：您可以在需要时自行打开页面。

我可以使用哪些人工智能模型？

所有的人。 Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite、Kimi K2、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.2、Claude Sonnet 5 和 Claude Opus 5 的资助方式相同。 没有锁定的等级：更强大的模型每回合花费更多的积分，因此会花费更多的时间。

广告商可以看到我的代码吗？

不会。广告位于浏览器的网页中，位于代理旁边，而不是代理内部。 您的代码、提示和项目名称永远不会发送给广告商。
